lastText: The Case Is ClosedThe WomanNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 26THE WOMAN: THE LETTERS WERE BURNEDThe photograph never comes home, and neither do the letters, which the King, who told you everything, has now no reason to fear. You keep the portrait. She had a copy of the whole of it, and used none of it, and you think, as you put the evening-dress photograph on your mantelpiece, that you know now what a woman can do with a weapon she has decided not to fire. He is remembered as the world prefers to remember him: sharp, odd, brilliant and a little aloof.
